## Draft copy

- RC-001 0.1.0 (draft): Allow PenniLogic to read bank and payment messages on this phone to record transactions? Messages are read on this phone only. You can withdraw consent at any time in settings.
- RC-002 0.1.0 (draft): Automatic capture needs the device permission to read messages. Without it, you can still add every transaction by hand.
- RC-003 0.1.0 (draft): This is not investment advice. Please consult a SEBI-registered investment adviser.
- RC-004 0.1.0 (draft): Your plan changes on the date shown. Features outside the new plan stop then, and your data stays yours to view and export.
- RC-005 0.1.0 (draft): Your refund request is recorded. The refund goes back to the original payment method once it is processed.
- RC-006 0.1.0 (draft): Account deletion permanently removes your account and its data. Records the law requires are kept only as long as required. This can't be undone.
- RC-007 0.1.0 (draft): A support operator has asked for support access to your records for a stated reason. Access is time-limited, logged and ends on its own.
- RC-008 0.1.0 (draft): We are looking into a security incident that may affect your account. We will tell you what happened and what to do next when we know more.
